meta.rule: Every colour here was read off a photograph of the real place. `from` names the photograph. Nothing is pasted from a photograph: these are colours and proportions, drawn again.

photos.central-1: 黑河中央街-1-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Central Street by day: long six-storey blocks in salmon render with cream panels and pilasters, gables on the cornice, a corner tower with a red cone, shop boards along the ground floor, grey stone paving, stone ball bollards.
photos.central-2: 黑河中央街-2-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. The other end of Central Street: a red building with white pilasters, arches and cornices under green domes, a pale grey classical front with a tall arched window, a green bank board with gold letters, a brick chimney, signs in Chinese and Russian.
photos.street-night-1: Streets of Heihe 04.01.2026.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0. A residential street on a January night: yellow walls with crimson balcony bands, white window frames, glazed balconies, blue and purple shop boards, pollarded trees, sodium lamps, thin packed snow on wet asphalt, brick pavement.
photos.street-night-2: Streets of Heihe 04.01.2026 (2).jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0. Red brick pavement, white tile and red brick low buildings with roller shutters, salmon blocks with yellow bay bands, dirty snow along the kerb, white cars with blue plates.
photos.goods-street: 黑河市俄罗斯商品街.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Tan tile blocks with cream bands and glazed balconies, a teal iron arch, globe lamps on black posts, steps up to raised shops.
photos.mother: 黑河市，母亲雕塑2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. The Mother sculpture: green bronze on a tall dark red polished granite plinth with green characters; Blagoveshchensk across the river is low, brick-orange and white.
